question: Authorize an execution-free Stage C design and implementation for directional and finite-range nonlocal defect model classes, reusing the accepted Stage A and Stage B contracts without rerunning them or executing an accepted parent?

options.summary: Design and implement authored-toy Stage C directional/nonlocal model-class behavior.
options.consequence: Create deterministic design, protocol, preflight, runner, independent verifier, schema, software-verification tests, and synchronized documentation, then stop before accepted-parent execution.
Retain the accepted Stage B boundary without Stage C design or implementation.

recommendation: AUTHORIZE_EXECUTION_FREE_STAGE_C_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION because Stage C is the smallest continuation that tests genuinely two-dimensional directional and nonlocal model-class discrimination before finite-size or material work.
safe_scope: Use only authored synthetic toy coefficients and the accepted represented-space, gauge, symmetry, schedule, locality, and model-class contracts; implement deterministic local software behavior and independent verification without reading or executing the accepted periodic parent.
blocked_scope: Accepted-parent Stage C execution, Stage B reruns, Stages D and E, material-specific DFT, production Wannier90, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, material transfer, new dependencies, publication, release, deposit, and external transmission remain unauthorized.
authorized_scope: Design and implement only the execution-free Stage C directional and finite-range nonlocal model-class package, including authored-toy positive and adverse controls, deterministic schema, independent verifier, maintained software-verification tests, and synchronized local documentation; do not read or execute an accepted scientific parent.
